svg.title: Тяга горизонтального блока обратным хватом — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Seated underhand reverse-grip cable row, 45-degree side-front view. One straight horizontal bar with central cable attachment; both hands shoulder-width and clearly UNDERHAND with palms facing upward, wrists straight, thumbs outward. Distinct fingers curl up from underneath the bar. A single line from the center attachment to a low pulley in front is fully visible. Person sits on low bench with feet on machine footrests and knees lightly bent, torso erect. Left arms reach toward machine; right elbows pulled back close to ribs, bar near lower abdomen. Same underhand grip and same equipment both frames. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
